_comment: THE A/A NULL — one per batch, MANDATORY, and sized like the treatment cells.
CELLS ARE DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN: every board any scheduled spec in this batch
runs on appears here, because a treatment metric with no floor in the A/A
cell is UNREADABLE rather than null, and an unfloored treatment cell is box
time spent on a row nobody may read. This batch floors:
headline-mix-king, snake5-knight, null-snake6, snake5-queen, hazard-mix-king
Run with two arms that are the SAME bundle and the SAME env under two names:
--arm nullA=<bundle-search-arch> --arm nullB=<bundle-search-arch>
Its paired delta measures run-to-run variance and nothing else. That number
is the yardstick every treatment delta in this batch is read against.
LIKE WITH LIKE, AND WHICH LIKE: both arms are claude/cluster-lookahead
(origin/claude/cluster-lookahead) — the feature branch.
tools/simworker/build-bot.sh origin/claude/cluster-lookahead <bundle-search-arch> --fetch
LIKE WITH LIKE, AND IT IS THE SAME CONVENTION BATCH 1 USED. An A/A null is
ONE bundle seated twice under two names (verify-null.js asserts an identical
bundle SHA in both arms), so a cross-branch batch has to choose which bundle
that is. The kit's convention is the bundle the batch's arms SHARE: batch 1
floored on `integrated` @ 66904d256103 because that build was the base arm
of P1, P2 and P3, and then read P1 — integrated against perf-substrate, two
different branches — against that floor. Batch 2's shared bundle is the
search-architecture tip: it is the base arm of P7F, P9, P10, P12, P13, X9
and all three budget rungs, and one of P11's two arms. So the null is TWO
SEARCH-ARCHITECTURE BUILDS.
P11's baseline arm therefore has no floor of its own, and that asymmetry is
named rather than hidden. It is the same asymmetry batch 1 accepted in the
other direction. What makes it tolerable is what the floor is a fact ABOUT:
the arms are launched at the same instant on the same boards with the same
seeds and pair by gameId, so the paired delta's floor is dominated by the
board and the box rather than by which of two builds of one repository
generated the moves. A reader who wants that assumption tested should
schedule a second null pair on the baseline bundle; it is the cheapest box
time available and nothing here forbids it.
SIZED AT 16 BLOCKS to match the treatment cells. A null at 4 blocks
beside a treatment at 16 understates the floor, because the floor narrows
with block count — the direction that makes a treatment look significant
when it is not.
Batch 20260827 measured this floor at +/-0.097 (mix-king) and +/-0.032
(snake6) with 0 illegal and 0 errors. Those are the numbers to beat, and a
wider band this time is an INSTRUMENT EVENT, not a nuisance.
Then check it:
node tools/simworker/bin/verify-null.js --batch <dir> --null nullA,nullB
